messages:
talia: billing pinged: Console and quotas showing project=infra-scripts while token introspect returns project=client-eden. looks like header vs claim ordering again
omar: saw same in traces. proxy still writes X-Project for legacy integrations and some services prefer that header for display/quotas
jess: historical compat choice. proposal: make validated token claim `project` canonical when present; header only if claim missing. add metric attribution names to be explicit
talia: metrics: add `attribution_source_v2{source:introspect|header|none}` and `attrib_mismatch_rate` (per-org tag). also emit `attrib_mismatch_sample` for sampled traces (limit 1/sec/org, 500/sec global)
omar: implementation: auth-exchange will compute X-Effective-Project as: introspect.claim.project -> org.legacy_attrib_flag -> X-Project header -> anonymous_project. add FF `ff/attrib_claims_first` for per-cluster rollout
jess: Console UX: in request inspector show "Attribution (effective): token claim (validated)" or "Attribution (effective): header (legacy)". when mismatch show a small info link to migration docs, avoid big warnings
talia: rollout plan: 1) telemetry + dashboards 2) unit + integration tests 3) enable behind FF at 1% canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 48h observe windows 4) expose Org Setting "legacy_attrib_mode" (default ON for existing orgs, OFF for new orgs)
omar: BC/comms: we'll email org admins who appear in the top mismatch list. deprecation timeline: 120 days notice before changing existing org defaults
jess: alerts: abort if `attrib_mismatch_rate` spikes >4x baseline or any single project sees quota burn delta >25%/hour during canary. billing team wants a daily top-30 mismatch digest while canary runs
costs-oncall: we'll monitor billing signals. ping 24h before canary with runbook and deets on alert channels
talia: migration help: include example JWT flows showing `project` claim in tokens, and quick server-side exchange snippet for common SDKs
omar: PR will include unit tests asserting precedence and an integration test that simulates header vs claim mismatches across routing paths. will add per-org toggle wiring and FF gating
jess: I'll design the Console toggle and the small help copy. keep the UI minimal and link to docs	ops-bot: Created INF-11022: "Use token claims as canonical project attribution; add telemetry and org legacy toggle" assigned to omar, talia
costs-oncall: please attach the alert thresholds and runbook to INF-11022. we'll be on-call during rollout window
talia: keeping PR links & runbook in INF-11022. anyone object to the plan? silence -> proceeding. thanks all
omar: opening PR now, will link it in INF-11022
jess: will mock the inspector change and attach screenshots to the ticket
talia: thanks team, small code-change but high impact for billing correctness. moving follow-ups to the ticket
